rows.text: returns 1 when `rdx` or `r8` is null and 5 when `r8` is below `rdx` (unsigned); otherwise, with `len` = `r8d` - `edx` (32-bit), calls `0059FC20` + 0x3A(`rdx`, `len`+1) and returns `0xd` when that returns null; else it writes byte 0 at offset `len` of the returned buffer, calls `0059FC20` + 0x5C(`rcx`, buffer) and returns 0

returns 0 when `ecx` is 0; otherwise calls `005E3040` + 0x26(`ecx`*8, 8) and returns null when that returns null; else copies `r8d` qwords from `rdx` to the returned block, zeroes the remaining `ecx` - `r8d` qwords after them with `rep stosq` (skipped when that count is 0) and returns the block

notes: 0059FC20: the length is computed in 32 bits (sub ebx, eax) after a 64-bit unsigned range check. 005E3040: the per-element null test on the destination at 005E3088 cannot fail after the null check on the block and is not stated; the rep stosq at 005E30A9 is not used as an anchor because its mnemonic token is ambiguous (rep prefix).
